summary:
- **[key4hep/DDML#16](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/16)** — The ML inference model initialization was moved out of the event loop and into a dedicated pre-event-loop phase, removing lazy-initialization state from `runInference`. The geometry initialization was deferred so that DD4hep settings are available, and the default was switched to non-hadron showers, which changes behavior for existing DDML configurations.
- **[key4hep/DDML#20](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/20)** — A correctness fix ensured that only the number of output elements actually returned by the inference model is copied into the output buffer, rather than filling to buffer capacity. This previously resulted in garbage data being read past the real inference results, which had been latent but could produce incorrect downstream results once the trailing data was consumed.
- **[key4hep/DDML#31](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/31)** — The custom `FindOnnxRuntime.cmake` module was removed in favor of the `onnxruntime::onnxruntime` CMake target, effectively mandating onnxruntime >= 1.16 for DDML builds.
- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#162](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/162)** — The DelphesEDM4HepConverter now assumes the pion mass in the energy calculation for all tracks except electrons and muons, ensuring mass/energy/momentum consistency for all tracks. PDG IDs are now populated for tracks and leptons so analysts no longer need to infer particle identity from mass, which is a user-visible behavior change for downstream analyses.
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#101](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/101)** — Several correctness fixes were applied to the GenFit-based TrackFitter: units in the helix-to-Cartesian Jacobian and z0 conversion were corrected for consistency between GENFIT and EDM4hep, a singular initial covariance in z0 near the reference point was prevented, and broken hit-track associations from the filtering stage were restored. The construction of AtFirstHit, AtLastHit, and AtIP track states was reworked to use GENFIT's native extrapolation.
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/97)** — A new `K4RECTRACKER_TRACKING` CMake flag (default ON) was added to gate compilation of the FCCee tracking components, enabling the package to build in stacks (such as muon collider) that do not ship Marlin/LCIO. Downstream spack/lcgcmake packaging must propagate this flag.
- **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#489](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/489)** — The deprecated `inputReader` python module was removed; it relied on `PodioInput`, which has been dropped from `k4FWCore`. Users must migrate to `k4MarlinWrapper.io_helpers`.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#433](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/433)** — A long-standing bug preventing boolean properties from being switched off on the `k4run` command line was fixed. A dedicated parser now accepts `True/False`, `true/false`, and `1/0` and rejects anything else, and a bare flag (e.g. `--MetadataSvc.SkipIfSameValue`) now means `True` rather than being converted to `False`, which is a user-visible behavior change for existing command-line invocations.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#436](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/436)** — k4FWCore now requires Gaudi v41r1 or later for the EventContext data handle API, which did not make it into Gaudi 41.0.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#437](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/437)** — The k4FWCore python package is now installed to `${GAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR}` instead of a hardcoded `python` directory, matching the new Gaudi v41r0 install layout. Without this fix, nothing using IOSvc could run against Gaudi 41.
- **[key4hep/key4hep-spack#930](https://github.com/key4hep/key4hep-spack/pull/930)** — `k4_local_repo` was updated for the Gaudi 41 install layout: `PYTHONPATH` now includes `install/lib[64]/python<ver>/site-packages`, and `GAUDI_PLUGIN_PATH` is prepended with `install/lib[64]/gaudi-plugins`. This is required for local development against Gaudi 41 stacks.
- **[hep-fcc/k4RecCalorimeter#285](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/285)** — The custom `FindONNXRuntime.cmake` and its fallback were removed; onnxruntime >= 1.16.0 is now required to pick up the `onnxruntime::onnxruntime` CMake target.
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#383](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/383)** — A full IDEA option 2 reconstruction configuration (`IDEA_o2_v01`) and corresponding CTest were added based on the reduced geometry, bringing IDEA_o2 to feature parity with recent IDEA_o1 updates. This provides a usable end-to-end sim/digi/reco chain for the second IDEA option.
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#392](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/392)** — TRAPPIST neural-network particle identification was integrated into ALLEGRO `o1_v03` and `o2_v01` reconstruction configurations for both topoclusters and sliding-window clusters, with corresponding CTest coverage. For SW clusters, `PairCaloClustersPi0` was made to work on clusters without `ShapeParameters`, allowing a baseline (non-optimised) performance assessment.
- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1684](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1684)** — The EDM4hep reader in DDG4 was changed to use the end vertex of parent-less particles (defaulting to the origin when absent), aligning its behavior with `HepMC3EventReader`. This produces consistent ddsim results across HepMC and EDM4hep intermediate formats.
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#95](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/95)** — Local ACTS-to-EDM4hep conversion was replaced by the centralised `ActsPlugins::EDM4hepUtil` converter, with `AtFirstHit` and `AtCalorimeter` track states built via `writeTrackState`. The track state covariance layout was corrected to follow `edm4hep::TrackParams` ordering, so downstream consumers now read the correct covariance elements — a user-visible behavior change.
- **[key4hep/k4geo#665](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/665)** — The IDEA `o1_v03` example steering file was updated to set the DD4hep worker event-sharing flag to false when running single-threaded, working around an upstream DD4hep issue that affected single-threaded runs.
